Lockout Stations guide

What Is a Lockout Station?

Location tipPlace the station on a wall close to the lockout points and clearly visible to everyone on the team.

A LOTO station is also known in the field as a LOTO board or lockout station. Safety padlocks, lockout hasps, valve and circuit breaker lockout devices, and warning tags are stored neatly and visibly in this board or cabinet. It is most often positioned at the entrance of panel rooms, maintenance workshops or production lines.

The station's real contribution is making the LOTO program sustainable. Since every piece of equipment has a specific place, a lost or missing item is immediately noticeable; workers reach the lock they need before energy isolation without searching. In shadow board models, the silhouette of each item is marked, so order is maintained on its own and it is easy to track who uses which equipment.

At Sofilx LOTO, we supply cover-free and covered wall stations, acrylic, plastic and aluminium body models, metal LOTO cabinets, portable combination stations and key management boards. This way you can set up an arrangement that fits your team size and working environment.

Buying guide

How to Choose the Right Lockout Station?

Check these criteria before ordering. If you are unsure, send a photo and we will choose together.

Ask an expert
  • Capacity: Work out how many padlocks, lockout hasps and devices you will store, and leave room for equipment to be added later.
  • Need for a lid: In areas with a risk of dust, moisture or unauthorized access, prefer a model with a lid.
  • Body material: Plastic or acrylic bodies are sufficient for general use, while metal cabinets last longer in heavy industry.
  • Location: Mount the station on a wall close to the lockout points, visible and with nothing blocking the front.
  • Key control: If you need to track who holds which keys, add a key management board or permit control station.
  • Ready-made kit: If you want to buy the station together with padlocks and devices, consider LOTO kits with a station.
Applications

Where Are Lockout Stations Used?

Electrical panel rooms

Before electrical maintenance, circuit breaker lockout devices and padlocks are kept at hand.

Production lines

A station placed at the head of the line brings the equipment needed for machine maintenance right next to the operator.

Maintenance workshops

All LOTO equipment in the facility is gathered in one place, and missing items are easily noticed.

Shift-based facilities

Teams on different shifts share common equipment in an orderly and controlled way.

Frequently asked questions

About Lockout Stations

If you could not find the answer you are looking for, message us on WhatsApp and we will determine the right model together.

Ask on WhatsApp
Are a LOTO station and a lockout station the same product?
Yes. Both names refer to a wall board or cabinet where locks, lockout hasps, lockout devices and warning tags are stored.
What do lockout station prices depend on?
The price varies depending on whether it has a cover, the body material, the capacity and whether the station is empty or fully stocked. For a current quote, you can message the product code to our WhatsApp line or call us by phone.
Is it mandatory to use a lockout station?
Although regulations do not directly require a station, an effective LOTO program requires equipment to be kept organized and accessible. A station is the most practical way to achieve this.
Should I buy a model with or without a cover?
Models without a cover are suitable for quick access in clean indoor areas. In dusty, humid areas or where there is a risk of unauthorized use, a model with a cover should be preferred.
Are stations delivered empty?
Stations are offered on their own, empty. If you want a solution filled with locks and devices, take a look at LOTO kits with stations.
Is the wall station hard to install?
Wall-mounted models are fixed quickly with wall plugs and screws. Portable models require no installation.
Is it possible to keep keys on a separate board?
Yes. The BD-B60 hook key management station and the BD-B61 metal key storage cabinet are used for this purpose.

Lockout Station Prices and Models

The first requirement of an effective LOTO program is that the lockout equipment is in the right place and complete. Lockout station models gather safety padlocks, lockout hasps and warning tags on a single board, shortening preparation time before maintenance and making visible who holds which equipment.

The Sofilx LOTO category offers options for different needs, from cover-free mini stations to covered wall models, from combination stations to metal LOTO cabinets and portable solutions. Key management boards and permit control stations make group lockout processes more controlled.

The price of a lockout station varies by body material, cover design, capacity and whether it comes as a set. To determine the model that suits your needs and get a current quote, you can reach us on our WhatsApp line or by phone.
